ITEM.PTXT: When the vehicle is stopped, pressing the off-hook switch of the telephone switch, or touching "TEL" on the information mode screen displayed by pressing the "Information/G" panel switch, changes the screen to the telephone number input screen, from which calls can be made by the following methods.

ENTRY.PTXT: Enter a telephone number to make a call.
Call up a telephone number from the phonebook to make a call.
Select a pre-registered telephone number (one-touch dial) to make a call.
Call up a number previously called or a number from which a call was previously received to make a call.

HINT.PTXT: In addition to the above basic calling functions, calls can be made from the navigation screen (when telephone number data is available) and by voice recognition, allowing calls to be made in various situations.
